work.note: Real credits only. Every one of these was a team effort. The role listed is the part I played, not the show's design credit. Plots and drawings were done alongside the team at Voyage Productions.

Crew chief on the lighting side, festivals included. The production's lighting designer held the design.

billing.label: HOW IT'S BILLED
billing.title: Per project. Separate line.
billing.text: Design is quoted per project, on its own line, separate from production. You can hand the file to SuperTech LX or to any vendor you already trust. Either way the design credit stays with Revelator Illuminae.
